description: chiplet_xml_composer's OWN material-property sidecar. This has no counterpart in the real .chiplet/interconnect_methods.json ecosystem - IHP's own interconnect_methods.json only names materials (layer_registry.<name>.material, methods.<id>.connection_stack.layers[].material), it never carries electrical/thermal properties for them. Every value here is deliberately sourced below rather than guessed, since chiplet_xml_composer never invents a material property at merge time - it requires one to be defined, here or in a --stackup input file, and refuses to run otherwise.

CuPillar.source: Bulk copper conductivity (resistivity 1.68 uOhm*cm, a standard physical reference value - e.g. CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics). Used as-is for the electroplated Cu pillar body; no specific, independently-verified conductivity figure for electroplated Cu pillar microstructure specifically was found, so this is bulk copper, not a pillar-derated value.

SnAgSolder.source: Within the published resistivity range for SAC305 (Sn96.5/Ag3.0/Cu0.5) solder, 13.0-14.5 uOhm*cm -> 6.9e6-7.7e6 S/m. See https://us.rs-online.com/m/d/8d9ef1f686bf70839a288bf4fd8e669e.pdf and https://www.researchgate.net/figure/Electrical-resistivity-of-SAC305-solder-alloy-with-different-surface-finish_fig4_338055862

Underfill.source: Typical epoxy-resin flip-chip underfill: dielectric constant ~3.5-3.8, loss tangent ~0.018-0.02. See https://imapsource.org/api/v1/articles/56030-flip-chip-underfill-rf-characterization.pdf and https://www.researchgate.net/publication/224153258_Design_of_Flip-Chip_Interconnect_Using_Epoxy-Based_Underfill_Up_to_V_-Band_Frequencies_With_Excellent_Reliability - real formulations vary; consult a supplier datasheet for a specific product.
